description: Use this when the person asks you to remember something about their revenue: a deal decision, a reason a deal was won or lost, an ICP refinement, a metric update or a strategic pivot. Saving an existing key keeps the previous value in its history.

category.description: What kind of memory this is.

confidence.description: How confident this memory is (0.0-1.0). Default: 1.0 for founder-stated facts.

domain.description: Business domain this memory relates to. Default: general.

key.description: Unique identifier for this memory (lowercase_underscored, e.g., "current_arr", "acme_deal_stage").

memoryType.description: episodic=time-bound fact, semantic=general pattern, procedural=behavioral habit. Default: episodic.

value.description: The memory content — a concise, specific fact or insight.

name: log_revenue_insight
title: Save a revenue insight
